title: pesto — visual design contract
summary: Visual design contract defining color tokens, palettes, colormaps, scale controls, layout, views, overlays, basemaps, states and accessibility for pesto.
notes: Path convention */specs/* plus contract-style tables (tokens, palettes, ramps, state matrix) → SPEC. 'Status: approved' is a document status, not an ADR Accepted marker; no Context/Decision/Consequences structure, so not ADR and not locked.
